product.olivetti-m21.summary: The M24 architecture in a transportable with a 9-inch amber screen and a keyboard that closes over the front.
product.olivetti-m21.history: Announced in 1984 alongside the M24, the M21 let users transport a complete office computer, with an integrated monitor and a keyboard serving as its lid. In November, Practical Computing quoted a UK price of £1,545 plus VAT for 128 KB and one floppy drive; its review unit was still a prototype. The magazine places manufacture in Italy and distribution with British Olivetti. The shared technical manual confirms its relationship to the M24. Sources: Practical Computing, November 1984, p. 55, and Olivetti, Theory of Operation.
product.olivetti-m21.warning: Experimental M21 profile with BIOS 1.44, a single floppy drive and amber OGC display.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.configura: Its display and floppy drives travel inside the case. The 1984 review describes a 9-inch amber CRT and one or two 360 KB drives. Olivetti specifies an 8 MHz CPU; Museo Tecnologicamente lists 4 MHz, an unresolved discrepancy rather than proof of another revision.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.video: Video extends the PC’s graphics capabilities. The proprietary controller combines a 6845 and 32 KB RAM: compatible 320 × 200 and 640 × 200 modes plus monochrome 640 × 400. The optional graphics expansion is a separate board.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.expansion: The transportable case leaves less room for cards. Its Bus Converter has three 62-contact connectors and one additional 38-contact connector, versus seven and four in the M24. The guide identifies board IF249 for the M21.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.firmware: BluMach uses the 1.44 BIOS, preserved as two 8 KiB halves traced to a physical M21. The Olivetti service guide also lists 1.43 PQBK/PQBL for the family.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.verified: With BIOS 1.44 and 128 KiB, the profile booted from a 360 KiB floppy. Floppy reads and writes, F1, Ctrl+Alt+Delete and hard reset passed. The amber 640 × 400 OGC test matched every pixel.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.limitatio: The amber palette approximates the built-in CRT. The precise donor board revision, CRT signal, original keyboard behaviour, IF249 expansion, optional storage and other memory and drive configurations still need validation.
product.olivetti-m21.technical.source_se: Olivetti, Personal Computer Pocket Service Guide, vol. I, pp. 1-1–1-2 (PDF 8–9).
product.olivetti-m21.technical.source_bi: Olivetti M21 BIOS 1.44 memory dump and even/odd ROM identification, VCFed.
product.olivetti-m21.creation.firmware: BIOS 1.44 and OGC PQBQ character ROM
product.olivetti-m21.creation.note: This initial profile uses the internal amber OGC display and boots from floppy.
